description: This file defines the 'Terms' result class for the Coocook schema, including methods for handling term validity, navigation between terms, and constraints related to terms and their associated users.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Result::Terms
classes.description: A class representing the 'terms' table in the database, with methods for managing term validity and relationships.

methods.name: cmp_validity_today
methods.description: Compares the 'valid_from' date of the term with today's date, returning -1, 0, or +1 depending on whether the term is in the past, today, or in the future.

methods.name: is_valid_today
methods.description: Checks if the term is valid today by comparing 'valid_from' with today's date.

methods.name: reasons_to_freeze
methods.description: Returns reasons why the term cannot be edited, such as being in the past or having associated users.

methods.name: reasons_to_keep
methods.description: Returns reasons why the term cannot be deleted, based on its position in the timeline and associated data.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next term relative to the current one, default offset +1.

methods.name: previous
methods.description: Returns the previous term relative to the current one, default offset -1.

methods.name: neighbor
methods.description: Returns a neighboring term offset by a specified number of steps, positive or negative.

methods.name: neighbors
methods.description: Returns a set of terms before or after the current term depending on the direction.

methods.name: valid_until
methods.description: Returns the date until which the current term is valid, or undefined if no successor exists.
